_about: Every docs screenshot shoot.mjs takes. name = the scenario step that takes it; file is relative to docs/images (default guide/<name>.png); page = the docs page that shows it; selector = what must be on screen (scrolled into view, block 'nearest' unless given; scroll false = leave the page as it is). Every shot is the 1680x1050 viewport, or the part of it that its crop entry names, taken in the light theme (<name>.png) and again in the dark theme (<name>-dark.png, written by shoot() itself; no entry needed). crop = {selector, union, top, bottom, pad, within, scrollTo}, all but selector optional: clip to the element selector names (joined with the boxes of the selectors in union), optionally from the top of one element to the bottom of another (to trim empty space), grown by pad (4 px) and held inside the viewport or inside the element within names; scrollTo brings an element to the top of its scroller first. The shot's own selector must lie inside the clip, or the run fails. See cropClip() in shoot.mjs. A page about one panel or dialog gets a crop, so the plot or form reads at the docs' content width; a page that shows the whole app, or whose text points at two panels in one image, stays full-window. Page tasks add entries here and a matching shoot("<name>") call in shoot.mjs.
